description: The line plot titled “Finetuning for different r, Gazeta” illustrates the ROUGE-1 scores achieved by four different model configurations as a function of log r, where r is a hyperparameter likely related to the rank or scaling of the LoRA/AdaLoRA adaptation. The x-axis, labeled “log r”, spans from 0 to 9 with linear spacing and tick marks at integer intervals. The y-axis, labeled “ROUGE-1”, ranges from 0 to 35 with major gridlines every 5 units. Four distinct lines represent the configurations: “T5 + LoRA” (red circles, solid line) starts at ~23.5 at log r = 0 and remains nearly flat, peaking slightly at ~24.5 around log r = 6 before declining to ~24 at log r = 9. “MBart + LoRA” (purple circles, solid line) begins at ~5, dips to ~2.5 at log r = 2, then rises sharply to ~19 at log r = 4, continues to ~23 at log r = 8, and slightly drops to ~23.5 at log r = 9. “T5 + AdaLoRA” (green circles, solid line) starts at ~23.5, steadily increases to ~26 at log r = 4, then plateaus near ~30 from log r = 6 to 9. “MBart + AdaLoRA” (orange circles, solid line) begins at ~5, climbs steeply to ~19 at log r = 3, then rises more gradually to ~32 at log r = 4, and continues to climb slightly to ~33.5 by log r = 9, maintaining the highest performance across most of the range.
